caption: The program asks for up to 10 bytes; the C library puts fd, buf and 10 in rdi, rsi and rdx and traps with system call number 0 in rax; the kernel finds only 6 bytes left, copies 6, and the wrapper hands 6 back to the program.

spec.aria: A user program calls read(fd, buf, 10); the C library loads fd, buf and 10 into rdi, rsi and rdx and traps with system call number 0 in rax; the kernel copies the 6 bytes left in the file and returns 6, which the library passes back, so a later read returns 0 at end of file.
